process_area.title: Renewable Generation Investment, Capex & Project Development

value_stream.name: On-Site Renewable Energy & Prosumer Asset Operations

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, Sustainability/ESG Manager (links to VS-25), Real Estate (links to VS-20/VS-97), Finance (links to VS-17/VS-40), Facilities (links to VS-20.3)
fields.Trigger: Annual ESG/energy strategy (links to VS-25); portfolio capacity planning

workflows.name: Renewable Generation Portfolio Strategy & Site Prioritization

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-renew of "Energy Manager/Sustainability develop the renewable-portfolio strategy" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "Energy Manager/Real Estate score and prioritize candidate sites" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approve the portfolio strategy and roadmap, sequence capex against the…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-553 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Generation Investment, Capex & Project Development (PA-108.1).)
- operational: rigorous scoring (W3450); operational: portfolio governance and phasing
Pain Points / Risks: - **Site-mis-prioritization risk**: Low-yield sites selected ahead of high-yield; mitigated by rigorous scoring (W3450)
- **Capex-conflict risk**: Renewable capex crowds out store-growth capex; mitigated by portfolio governance and phasing
System Touchpoints: - Energy/asset master (links to VS-35/W399); ESG metrics (links to VS-25.1/W192); facility/real estate (links to VS-20/VS-97); capex (links to VS-40)

steps.activity: Energy Manager/Sustainability develop the renewable-portfolio strategy: target self-generation %, capex envelope and phasing, ownership-model preference (own/lease/PPA per W3455), alignment to the ESG/decarbonization target (links to VS-25.1/W192 GHG) and grid-resilience need (links to VS-07/W470), and store/DC/HQ prioritization criteria

Energy Manager/Real Estate score and prioritize candidate sites: roof area/condition/orientation/shading, structural capacity, site consumption profile (links to W111), DU/tariff and net-metering feasibility (links to W3462), and business-case attractiveness (W3451); produce the multi-year build roadmap

CFO/COO approve the portfolio strategy and roadmap, sequence capex against the corporate capex plan (links to VS-40/VS-33.1) and working capital (links to VS-105), and set the program governance (links to W3472); integrate to the ESG/sustainability plan (links to VS-25.3)

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, EPC/Engineering consultant, Real Estate (links to VS-20), Facilities (links to VS-20.3), Structural Engineer

workflows.name: Site Feasibility, Solar Resource Assessment & Structural/Capacity Evaluation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-match of "Energy Manager/EPC conduct site feasibility" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-export of "EPC/Engineering size the system" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-compile of "compile the feasibility report with go/no-go recommendation, expected…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-553 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Generation Investment, Capex & Project Development (PA-108.1).)
- operational: PVsyst and conservative assumptions; operational: structural evaluation upfront
Pain Points / Risks: - **Yield-overestimate risk**: Optimistic yield understates payback; mitigated by PVsyst and conservative assumptions
- **Structural-risk**: Roof cannot bear the load without costly reinforcement; mitigated by structural evaluation upfront
System Touchpoints: - Energy modeling tools; facility/asset master (links to VS-20/VS-35); permits (links to VS-22); CAAP clearance (links to VS-22/W480)

steps.activity: Energy Manager/EPC conduct site feasibility: solar resource assessment (irradiance/yield via PVsyst/satellite data), roof survey (area, orientation, tilt, shading, penetration), structural evaluation (roof load capacity for PV + access), electrical/interconnection point, and site consumption matching

EPC/Engineering size the system: kWp capacity, inverter type, optional battery storage (BESS), mounting (roof/carport/ground), generation estimate (kWh/yr), self-consumption ratio, and export potential; identify constraints (heritage, CAAP height clearance links to VS-22/W480, structural reinforcement)

Energy Manager compile the feasibility report with go/no-go recommendation, expected generation, capex/payback (W3451), risks, and interconnection/net-metering feasibility (W3462); obtain Real Estate/Facilities sign-off and proceed to business case

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, Finance/Treasury (links to VS-17/VS-18/VS-40), Sustainability (links to VS-25), Tax (links to VS-79)
fields.Trigger: Feasibility approved (W3450); capex cycle (links to VS-40)

workflows.name: Business Case, Capex Funding & Financing/Incentive Structuring

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-import of "Energy Manager/Finance build the business case" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-request of "Treasury/Finance structure the funding" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track assumption validity through delivery" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-553 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Generation Investment, Capex & Project Development (PA-108.1).)
- operational: conservative incentive assumption and sensitivity; operational: green-finance sourcing and ownership-model optimization (W3455)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Incentive-dependence risk**: Business case unviable without incentives that may change; mitigated by conservative incentive assumption and sensitivity
- **Funding-cost risk**: High financing cost erodes IRR; mitigated by green-finance sourcing and ownership-model optimization (W3455)
System Touchpoints: - Capex (links to VS-40); treasury/debt (links to VS-18); tax/incentives (links to VS-79/VS-87); ESG (links to VS-25); cash forecast (links to VS-18.1)

steps.activity: Energy Manager/Finance build the business case: capex, OpEx (O&M, insurance links to VS-26), generation/savings (kWh × tariff), net-metering/export revenue (links to W3463), incentives (BOI/PEZA, RE Act, duty-free import links to VS-79/VS-87), depreciation, asset-retirement, and payback/IRR/NPV; compare ownership models (W3455)

Treasury/Finance structure the funding: own-capex (links to VS-40 capex request/approval), debt/green-loan (links to VS-18 W319), lease/PPA (W3455), or third-party ownership; optimize for incentives, tax, and PFRS treatment (W3455); secure board approval per authority (links to VS-36)

Energy Manager/Finance lock the business case and capex authorization, integrate to the capex pipeline (links to VS-40) and cash forecast (links to VS-18.1/VS-105), and track assumption validity through delivery; report portfolio economics to governance (W3472)

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Project Mgmt, EPC Vendor

workflows.name: EPC Vendor Selection, Contracting & Project Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "reference checks, and ranking" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-schedule of "schedule, site coordination with store/DC ops" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-553 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Generation Investment, Capex & Project Development (PA-108.1).)
- operational: performance LD and warranty; operational: milestone management and site coordination
Pain Points / Risks: - **EPC-underperformance risk**: Vendor misses yield/availability guarantee; mitigated by performance LD and warranty
- **Schedule-slip risk**: Delays defer savings and clash with store ops; mitigated by milestone management and site coordination
System Touchpoints: - Procurement/vendor (links to VS-03/VS-34); contract (links to VS-100.3/W402); HSE (links to VS-24); insurance (links to VS-26); project/capex (links to VS-40)

steps.activity: Procurement/Energy Manager run the EPC vendor selection (links to VS-03/VS-34): RFP, pre-qualification, technical/commercial evaluation, reference checks, and ranking; select per authority and framework-agreement where volume warrants

Legal/Energy Manager negotiate and execute the EPC contract: scope, spec, price, milestone payments, liquidated damages, performance guarantee (yield availability), warranty, HSE (links to VS-24), insurance (links to VS-26), and termination; ensure risk allocation (links to VS-100.3/W230)

Project Manager/Energy Manager manage the EPC delivery: schedule, site coordination with store/DC ops (links to VS-07/VS-04), HSE, quality, change control, milestone acceptance, and commissioning handoff (W3454); report status and resolve issues

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, Procurement (links to VS-03), EPC, Quality (links to VS-31), Vendor
fields.Volume: PV modules, inverters, mounting, BESS, monitoring per site

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "Energy Manager/EPC specify the equipment" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-inspect of "Procurement/EPC procure the equipment" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "verify equipment authenticity" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-553 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Generation Investment, Capex & Project Development (PA-108.1).)
- operational: tier-1 spec and anti-counterfeit (links to VS-71); operational: procurement planning and buffer
Pain Points / Risks: - **Counterfeit/grade-B risk**: Substandard modules/inverters under-perform and fail early; mitigated by tier-1 spec and anti-counterfeit (links to VS-71)
- **Lead-time risk**: Import/equipment delay slips the project; mitigated by procurement planning and buffer
System Touchpoints: - Procurement/import (links to VS-03/VS-02.2/VS-87); quality (links to VS-31); anti-counterfeit (links to VS-71); asset register (links to VS-35/W399)
Time Estimate: - Per project; aligned to EPC schedule

steps.activity: Energy Manager/EPC specify the equipment: PV module (tier-1, wattage, efficiency, warranty), inverter (string/central/micro, efficiency, monitoring), mounting/racking, BESS (chemistry, capacity, cycle life), cabling/protection, and monitoring/SCADA; ensure compatibility and code compliance

Procurement/EPC procure the equipment: vendor selection (links to VS-03), import/customs for imported equipment (links to VS-02.2/VS-87 incl. duty-free/incentive), quality inspection (links to VS-31) on receipt, and warranty/serial capture; manage lead times vs project schedule

Quality/Energy Manager verify equipment authenticity (anti-counterfeit links to VS-71), factory/acceptance testing, serial/BOM capture for asset register (links to VS-35/W399) and warranty, and handoff to construction (W3454); resolve defects

fields.Participants: Project Manager, Energy Manager, EPC, Facilities (links to VS-20.3), HSE (links to VS-24), DU/Inspector

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitoring, and HSE compliance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "checks, interconnection with DU" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "conduct asset acceptance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-553 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Generation Investment, Capex & Project Development (PA-108.1).)
- operational: performance test and LD (W3452); operational: under-performs guarantee; operational: HSE controls (links to VS-24)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Performance-shortfall risk**: System under-performs guarantee; mitigated by performance test and LD (W3452)
- **Safety/incident risk**: Construction on live retail sites; mitigated by HSE controls (links to VS-24)
System Touchpoints: - HSE (links to VS-24); permits/inspection (links to VS-22); interconnection (links to W3462); asset register (links to VS-35)

steps.activity: EPC/Project Manager execute construction safely: site mobilization, structural works/mounting, module/inverter/BESS installation, DC/AC works, SCADA/monitoring, and HSE compliance (links to VS-24); coordinate with live store/DC operations (links to VS-07/VS-04) to minimize disruption

EPC/Energy Manager commission and test: pre-energization checks, interconnection with DU (links to W3462), performance/ratio test, yield verification vs spec, SCADA validation, and safety/protection testing; DU/electrical inspection and energization permit (links to VS-22)

Project Manager/Energy Manager conduct asset acceptance: punch-list closure, performance acceptance vs guarantee (W3452), documentation handover (as-built, O&M manual, warranties, serials), and handover to operations (W3456); capture lessons

fields.Participants: CFO, Treasury (links to VS-18), Tax (links to VS-79), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Energy Manager, Sustainability (links to VS-25)

workflows.name: Ownership-Model Selection: Own / Lease / PPA / RECOA Structuring

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "accounting, tax, and ESG-attribute ownership" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "document the chosen model" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "Finance/Tax lock the accounting treatment" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-553 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Generation Investment, Capex & Project Development (PA-108.1).)
- operational: tax/finance/legal review; operational: attribute-ownership clause (W3465)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Accounting-misclassification risk**: Wrong PFRS 16/PPA treatment distorts the balance sheet; mitigated by tax/finance/legal review
- **ESG-attribute-loss risk**: PPA/lease transfers REC ownership, losing the decarbonization credit; mitigated by attribute-ownership clause (W3465)
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/debt (links to VS-18); lease accounting (links to VS-17/W275); tax/incentive (links to VS-79); legal (links to VS-100.3); ESG (links to VS-25)

steps.activity: Treasury/Finance evaluate ownership models: own-and-operate (capex, depreciation, ITC/incentive capture, PFRS 16 n/a), operating lease / PPA (third-party owns/sells kWh, off-balance-sheet, PFRS 16 ROU if lease), or RECOA/solar-services; model economics, accounting, tax, and ESG-attribute ownership (REC links to W3465) per model

Legal/Treasury structure and document the chosen model: PPA (price, term, availability, buy-out), lease (term, rent, ROU accounting links to VS-17/W275), or own-capex (links to VS-40); ensure regulatory compliance (ERC, DU, RE Act), incentive capture, and ESG-attribute ownership

Finance/Tax lock the accounting treatment (PFRS 16 ROU, asset recognition, incentive accounting, asset-retirement obligation links to VS-35), and integrate to financial reporting (links to VS-17) and ESG disclosure (links to VS-25.3/W192); document for audit (links to VS-21)

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, Fixed Asset (links to VS-35), Finance (links to VS-17), Facilities/O&M (links to VS-20.3), Master Data (links to VS-29)

workflows.name: Renewable Asset Registration, Capitalization & Handover to Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "capture, useful life, depreciation method, asset-retirement obligation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-monitor of "monitoring/SCADA access, O&M plan and vendor, and KPI targets" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-alert of "alerting, and confirm the asset is generating and settling" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-135 (ensure renewable asset registration & net-metering settlement.)
- operational: FA registration discipline (links to VS-35); operational: formal handover and O&M assignment
Pain Points / Risks: - **Registration-gap risk**: Asset not registered → depreciation/insurance/property-tax gaps; mitigated by FA registration discipline (links to VS-35)
- **Handover-ambiguity risk**: Unclear O&M ownership causes neglect; mitigated by formal handover and O&M assignment
System Touchpoints: - Fixed asset register (links to VS-35/W399); location master (links to W254/W16); energy/SCADA system; GL (links to VS-17.1)

steps.activity: Fixed Asset/Energy Manager register the renewable asset: asset tag, location (links to W254/W16), componentization (PV array, inverter, BESS, mounting, SCADA), capex/cost capture, useful life, depreciation method, asset-retirement obligation (links to VS-35), and warranty/serial linkage (W3453)

Energy Manager establish the operations baseline: rated capacity, expected generation, performance ratio, interconnection/net-metering registration status (W3462), monitoring/SCADA access, O&M plan and vendor, and KPI targets; load into the energy/asset management system

Energy Manager formally hand over the asset to operations (PA-108.2), train facility/O&M staff, activate monitoring/alerting, and confirm the asset is generating and settling (net-metering links to W3463); close the project and capture lessons (links to W3472)
